answers.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(t.fee_sats) AS REAL) / 100000000.0 AS value FROM transactions t WHERE t.height = 840000 AND t.is_coinbase = 0

SELECT CAST((SUM(o.value_sats) - b.subsidy_sats) AS REAL) / 100000000.0 AS value FROM transactions t JOIN outputs o ON o.height = t.height AND o.txid = t.txid JOIN blocks b ON b.height = t.height WHERE t.height = 840000 AND t.is_coinbase = 1
